WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(ili.derived_total_cost - ili.derived_product_cost) as avg_difference
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  INNER JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_difference) as mean_val
  FROM category_stats
),
filtered_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.avg_quantity,
    cs.avg_difference,
    om.mean_val
  FROM category_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE cs.avg_difference > om.mean_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_quantity),
  AVG(avg_difference),
  AVG(avg_difference - mean_val)
FROM filtered_categories
